audit.why: TRICKY at 6/10 fits a 48.87% win rate over 266 games and a chart Ornn owns early and loses from 6 onward. No stale percentage is quoted anywhere in the entry.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 3 (Levels 4-5) gave Ornn the stage in both layers, but the packet chart says Skill and both why-texts on that row already describe an even stage ('it becomes skill-based', 'you can answer his pillar pokes').
audit.why: The stage label contradicts the explanation printed directly beside it.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side and win[3] flipped to Skill as a matched pair; the existing 5/10 rating and why-text already fit.
sources: mirrorFindings (Ornn side flipped its win[3] to Skill)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls Searing Charge 'W into Q' and content.mid says Alpha Strike dodges 'his W-Q'. Searing Charge is E; the terrain he charges into is the pillar from Volcanic Rupture (Q); Bellows Breath is W and applies Brittle. Nothing stated that his knock-ups cancel Meditate.
audit.why: The knock-up only happens when he collides with terrain, so knowing the pillar is the setup is what tells you where not to stand. And Meditate is a channel any of his CC ends.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected throughout, the pillar named as the terrain he charges into, and the Meditate cancel stated in mid and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] told you to wait out his ult without saying how long that is.
audit.why: 140s at rank 1 is a huge window — it is the single best fighting gap in the matchup and the page never quantified it.

edits.before: Ornn's shielded brittle trades beat a squishy level-1 Yi.
edits.after: Ornn's Brittle trades and tank base stats beat a level-1 Yi.

edits.before: His armour and shield sustain hold lane control through level 3.
edits.after: His armour and Brittle amplification hold lane control at 3.

edits.before: Ornn bullies early with Bellows Breath brittle-and-shield trades and Searing Charge (W into Q) that knocks you up against terrain; a wall knock-up plus his DPS chunks you hard, so keep spacing off walls.
edits.after: Ornn bullies early with Bellows Breath's Brittle and Searing Charge (E) into his own Volcanic Rupture (Q) pillar, which knocks you up against terrain he just created; stay off walls and off his pillar.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God can hit you twice for a double knock-up, hard-interrupting Meditate and any Alpha Strike combo, so wait out his ult before committing to an all-in.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God can hit you twice for a double knock-up, and either hit cancels Meditate mid-channel; at 140s rank 1 it is a long gap, so all-in inside it.

edits.before: Ornn wins the opening levels: Bellows Breath shields and applies brittle so his trades beat yours, and Searing Charge can knock you into terrain for a heavy chunk, so stay off walls and just farm.
edits.after: Ornn wins the opening levels: Bellows Breath makes you Brittle so his follow-up hits harder, and Searing Charge knocks you up on any terrain — including the pillar his own Q leaves — so stay off walls and farm.

edits.before: From level 5 the lane tips your way — your Wuju Style true damage bypasses his early armour, Alpha Strike dodges his W-Q, and Meditate sustains through his brittle poke, though you must still respect his double knock-up ult.
edits.after: From level 5 the lane tips your way — Wuju Style true damage bypasses his armour, Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge Searing Charge (E), and Meditate sustains the Brittle poke, though any knock-up cancels that channel.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags 'Searing Charge' and 'Bellows Breath' as probable wrong names — both are Ornn's real E and W in the kit file, so those are false positives. Volcanic Rupture carries a derived 'grounding' flag but Riot's text describes only damage, a slow and a pillar, so I made no claim that it shuts off Alpha Strike (the Ornn-side audit reached the same conclusion).
